title: Cut-off of the pulled-back form: a continuous compactly supported covector field equal to ω(f(x))∘Df(x) on K
statement: Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ O compact, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q of class C¹ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O), and ω : ℝ^Q → Λⁿ(ℝ^Q) a continuous n-form (DifferentialForm (Euclid Q) n). Then there is a continuous, compactly supported covector field h : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (Covector (Euclid P) n) with h(x) = ω(f(x))∘Df(x) := (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x) for every x ∈ K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid Q) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid Q) n), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → Continuous ω → ∃ h : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous h ∧ HasCompactSupport h ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, h x = (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)
